final_contents.tests/drivers/sensor/adltc2990/prj.conf:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2023 Carl Zeiss Meditec AG
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

CONFIG_ZTEST=y

# Set log levels
CONFIG_I2C_LOG_LEVEL_WRN=y
CONFIG_I2C_LOG_LEVEL_DBG=y
CONFIG_SENSOR_LOG_LEVEL_WRN=y
CONFIG_LOG=y

# Enable sensors
CONFIG_SENSOR=y
CONFIG_ADLTC2990=y

# Enable emulation
CONFIG_EMUL=y

CONFIG_I2C=y
CONFIG_I2C_INIT_PRIORITY=40
# Enable Floating Point
CONFIG_FPU=y
